values.note: $35 a night for an RV: the $28 campsite fee plus Florida's $7 nightly utility fee for RVs (tent campers pay $28), plus tax and a $6.70 reservation fee per reservation. No out-of-state rate; Florida residents 65 and over get half off the campsite fee.

fees.source: Reserve Florida search/details for every unit of facilities 174 and 175 (all 138 units Rate 28.00, Fee 6.70), read 2026-10-21 + https://www.floridastateparks.org/fees ($7 nightly RV utility fee, as read 2026-10-12)

hookups.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/st-andrews-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('Each campsite features water, 30- and 50-amp electric, and sewer connections') + Reserve Florida search/details (50-amp, water and sewer on nearly every unit), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reserve Florida lists 135 'RV or Tent' sites (East Loop 81, West Loop 54) plus 3 tent-only sites; site lengths 21-50 ft (most 25-45), 17 pull-throughs.

values.note: Two bathhouses in the campground for registered campers; outdoor showers at the day-use parking areas.
